author: Kevin Kelly
short: Themed category help, /help and checked Red management controls.
description: Independently installable presentation layer for bundled Red Core and CogManagerUI. Supplies one-card permission-aware category help with requester-bound selectors and page buttons, complete command usage and /help; selected prefix/slash bot-management controls; and context-local styling of native management replies. Preserves native checks, converters, cooldowns, hooks, settings, commands and licensing/data-rights responses. Restores native help and removes its hook on unload. Stores no persistent data.
install_msg: Load with [p]load coreplus. CorePlus replaces Red's default help formatter; unload another custom help cog first. Existing Core commands remain available. Use [p]help or [p]core; enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog coreplus and [p]slash sync to get /help and /core. Guide: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/coreplus/README.md
end_user_data_statement: No persistent data. Help controls retain the requester's ID and channel in memory for up to three minutes. Native Core operations retain Red's own data policies. Privacy deletion closes owned help controls.
